shortcut.bigmoveobjectleft.note: WO023-3: the canvas body has no DOM selection — the object-move arrow is exercised on the react editor's only DOM text surface: the hf-caret pre enters footer editing (Insert ▸ Footer) with the caret at offset 1 of the 'Footer' text; ArrowLeft natively moves the caret one char left (offset 1->0)

shortcut.bigmoveobjectright.note: WO023-3: the canvas body has no DOM selection — the object-move arrow is exercised on the footer tiptap surface (hf-caret pre, caret at offset 1 of 'Footer'); ArrowRight natively moves the caret one char right (offset 1->2)

shortcut.bigmoveobjectup.note: WO023-3: the canvas body has no DOM selection — the object-move arrow is exercised on the footer tiptap surface (hf-caret pre, caret at offset 1 of the single 'Footer' line); ArrowUp clamps the caret to the line start (offset 1->0)

shortcut.bigmoveobjectdown.note: WO023-3: the canvas body has no DOM selection — the object-move arrow is exercised on the footer tiptap surface (hf-caret pre, caret at offset 1 of the single 'Footer' line); ArrowDown clamps the caret to the line end (offset 1->6)

shortcut.movefocustonextobject.note: WO023-3: the canvas body has no focusable objects — 'move focus to the next object' is exercised as native tab-order focus nav: the hf-caret pre focuses the footer contentEditable (the react editor's only DOM text surface); Tab moves activeElement to the next tabbable control (focus-moved)

shortcut.movefocustopreviousobject.note: WO023-3: the canvas body has no focusable objects — 'move focus to the previous object' is exercised as native tab-order focus nav: the hf-caret pre focuses the footer contentEditable; Shift+Tab moves activeElement back to the previous tabbable control (focus-moved)
